name: audit-seo-geo
description: Audit any website for SEO and GEO, made for freelancers and marketing teams: a few questions on your goals and offer, real AI answers, evidence for every finding, a fixed 30-criteria grid and three undated to-do lists, delivered as a web page to share. A 15-minute quick audit or a full one, in English or French, a comparison of two audits, and fixes applied in your code on a branch, then checked on your live site.
